changelog:
Initial release of the clawdhub skill.

- Provides ClawdHub CLI access to search, install, update, and publish agent skills.
- Supports 50+ AI models for image, video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, search, document parsing, email, and SMS.
- Unified API documentation for calling models directly by ID or via smart routing.
- Requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for authentication.
- Includes detailed usage examples for major features and model types.
summary: Use the ClawdHub CLI to search, install, update, and publish agent skills. And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech...
